test_box_equality: test that two Box instances with the same parameters are equal regardless of dtype
test_box_inequality: test that Box instances differ when name, low, high, or shape parameters differ
create_box_instance: create a Box space with low, high, name, shape, and dtype parameters
test_box_comparison: test Box equality and inequality assertions using the test_equal and test_not_equal functions
run_box_tests: run the Box space equality and inequality test suite via the main entry point
